dataset_identity.title: Experimental vibration data collected for a belt drive system under different operating conditions

scientific_domain_limitations.disclaimer: This dataset was collected from an experimental laboratory belt-drive test bench (G.U.N.T PT 500.14) under varying rotational speeds, belt pretension levels, and fault/unbalance states. It is NOT equivalent to conveyor belt joint rupture or splice pull-out data in an iron-ore mining environment. It is scientifically valid for vibration signal preprocessing, zero-mean calibration, baseline operational modeling, DSP feature extraction, and general belt anomaly detection.
authorized_uses: Vibration signal preprocessing and DC offset removal validation
DSP feature extraction validation (RMS, crest factor, kurtosis, FFT spectrum)
Operating condition representation (speed vs pretension baseline drift)
End-to-end pipeline verification before field hardware connection
prohibited_claims: Claiming the model is trained on real industrial conveyor splice rupture data
Claiming ISO conveyor belt compliance solely based on this test bench data

acquisition_specifications.machine_type: G.U.N.T PT 500.14 Belt Drive Machinery Diagnostic System

condition_classes.description: Healthy belt with eccentric unbalance weight (2.2g - 8.8g)
